events.text:
—❗️🇮🇷 NEW: The first handwritten note by the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei, has been released to the public
It is dated August 1st, 2026, addressed to IRGC Aerospace Commander Brigadier General Majid Mousavi, and confirms that Seyyed Mojtaba is in active correspondence with all relevant authorities and military officials.
The text is as follows:
‘In the Name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
To the brave and Mujahid brother, Brigadier General Seyyed Majid Mousavi—may God protect and support him.
After greetings and salutations:
1). Praise be to God: The report you submitted—a copy of which I had already received—is heartening and gratifying. You have written very little about your own efforts and those of your unsung, self-sacrificing comrades; such is one of the characteristic behaviors of the pious ones.
The outcome—by Divine Wisdom—stemming from this quality is, God willing, affection and esteem that the Almighty (Glory be to Him and Exalted be He) bestows upon the sincere, along with manifold blessings and manifest victories.
2). Regarding the [ballistic missile] supply chain, I hope efforts continue and that reports on the matter are conveyed to me on a regular basis.
3). Safeguarding your own precious life and the lives of all the brothers is my emphatic request. I hope that, through the blessed prayers of our Master (may God hasten his noble reappearance), all affairs will be set right.’

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
The UK has agreed to a time-limited agreement to support Saudi Arabia against mounting Houthi drone and missile strikes, including a recent attempt targeting Riyadh.
Starting in the coming days, the RAF will deploy one RAF Voyager tanker to provide purely defensive air-to-air refuelling for Saudi jets. The mission is strictly limited to defending against incoming aerial attacks rather than aiding offensive operations inside Yemen.
The decision comes as Houthi forces capture the critical port of Mocha and strategic Red Sea islands near the Bab al-Mandeb strait—a vital maritime corridor carrying 12% of global trade. UK officials emphasized the move aims to protect key regional oil pathways and stabilize broader economic and security interests.

events.title: Telegram
events.text:
Large-scale, combined missile and drone attack on Ukraine.
Preliminarily, the following missiles were used:
~11 Oniks-M supersonic cruise missiles.
~6 Zircon hypersonic cruise missiles.
~5 Kalibr cruise missiles
~4 Kn-23 ballistic missiles.
~2 Iskander-M ballistic missiles.
~28 missiles in total. 
Around 8 S8000 Banderol cruise missiles also targeted Kremenchuk. 
Strikes were carried out on the cities of Kryvyi Rih, Kremenchuk, Dnipro, and Pavlohrad, in Dnipropetrovak and Poltava Oblasts. 
Kryvyi Rih was struck by ~5 Kalibrs, ~2 Oniks-Ms, ~2 Kn-23, and ~2 Zircons. 
Kremenchuk was struck by ~5 Oniks-Ms and ~2 Iskander-M with cluster warheads.
Dnipro was struck by 4 Oniks-Ms and ~1 Kn-23. 
Pavlohrad was struck by ~4 Zircons and ~1 Kn-23. 
(These numbers will likely be adjusted further in the coming hours)
Targets hit include the Kryvyi Rih Metallurgical Plant, the Pavlohrad Chemical Plant, the Kremenchuk Oil Refinery, and an unknown industrial target in eastern Dnipro.

🇯🇵 Five geostrategic reasons why Japan's US-backed militarization could backfire
China has warned Japan over the deployment of the US Typhon missile system in Kyushu that brings China, Russia and North Korea within Japan’s striking range.
Japan’s assertive military doctrine clashes with its geography: any confrontation with the three powers Tokyo calls its greatest post-WWII security challenges would carry severe risks:
🔴 Japan lies within the short- and medium-range missile arcs of all three
🔴 Its geography leaves little strategic depth, exposing its population and critical infrastructure to attack
🔴 Unlike continental nations, Japan cannot disperse command centers, ammunition depots or airfields deep inland
🔴 Japan imports over 90% of its energy and critical minerals, and roughly 63% of its food on a caloric basis, making a sea blockade a critical vulnerability
🔴 The US, which encourages Japan’s militarization while maintaining bases there, would offer little help in a conflict, as the Iran war showed, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told Kenji Isezaki, a member of Japan’s House of Councilors.

🇮🇷 Iran moves to reverse-engineer captured US weapon tech
Iranian engineers will soon crack the secrets of the US-made Dive-LD unmanned underwater vehicle that was captured by the IRGC Navy in the Strait of Hormuz earlier this month, IRGC spokesman Brigadier General Hossein Mohebbi announced.
🔊“This advanced technology exists in the underwater vessel that fell into the hands of the IRGC Navy forces, and its reverse engineering will begin,” he said as quoted by PressTV.
The brigadier general also remarked that “the most advanced US technologies used in the military and defense industries have come under Iran’s control,” and that Iran acquired “a collection of different combat, support, transport, and reconnaissance aircraft.”
During and prior to the US-Israeli war against Iran, Iranian forces were able to capture a variety of US military hardware such as RQ-170 Sentinel and MQ-9 Reaper drones.
